source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        separator = grid[sep_row][0]
        shared = (set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)) - {separator}
        base = max(shared, key=lambda c: sum(x == c for row in a for x in row) + sum(x == c for row in b for x in row))
        return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    sep_col = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
    a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    separator = grid[0][sep_col]
    shared = (set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)) - {separator}
    base = max(shared, key=lambda c: sum(x == c for row in a for x in row) + sum(x == c for row in b for x in row))
    return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
'''
